title: Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.33035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. translated_title: 面向AI原生RAN控制的混合人工智能：一种功能视角
translated_abstract: AI原生无线接入网（RAN）控制涉及跨网络实体、协议层和时间尺度的相互关联的决策。要理解AI与传统方法如何共同支持这些决策，需要一个共同的基准来比较二者的功能角色。本综述提出了一种与技术无关的RAN决策分类框架，围绕四种互补能力进行组织：表示与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制以及决策综合。这些能力根据其在控制过程中的角色来定义，与实现它们的具体技术无关。基于这一视角，我们考察了代表性的AI方法和基于模型的方法，包括基础模型、世界模型、强化学习和优化。随后，我们将该分类框架应用于慢速、中速、快速及跨时间尺度应用中的代表性RAN控制解决方案，以识别其中所需的关键能力。
tldr: 本综述提出了一种与技术无关的功能性分类框架，将RAN决策分解为表示与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制和决策综合四种互补能力，为比较AI与传统方法在AI原生RAN控制中的混合协作提供了统一视角。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces a technique-agnostic functional taxonomy of RAN decision-making—organized around Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis—to provide a unified basis for understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support AI-native RAN control.
